If you are attracted to bold goals, believe in uncompromising honesty, support mutual respect, care about environmental responsibility, have a passion for excellence and a desire to make a positive contribution – then we want you to join the Husky TechnologiesTM team!

Job Description

As a Test Automation Engineer, you will design and implement automation solutions that validate system behavior across UI, APIs, and integrations. You will contribute to building a robust quality engineering ecosystem by integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and supporting continuous delivery.

In this role, you will translate requirements into effective test strategies, combining automation with manual, exploratory, and integration testing to ensure comprehensive quality coverage across all application layers.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys hands-on coding, solving complex validation challenges, and improving system quality at scale, while taking ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes and collaborating closely with cross-functional teams.

Responsibilities

Automation Development & Framework Ownership

- Design, develop, and own scalable test automation frameworks and reusable components
- Build automated test suites across:
- UI (Web/Mobile)
- API and integration layers
- Ensure automation solutions are maintainable, reliable, and extensible across teams

Test Strategy & Implementation

- Translate requirements into automation-ready test scenarios, test data, and validation strategies
- Contribute to test strategy, coverage planning, and quality goals
- Identify test gaps and proactively mitigate risks
- Perform automation feasibility analysis to determine optimal test approach (manual vs automated)

Delivery & Execution Excellence

- Execute a balanced mix of automated and manual tests aligned with sprint goals, ensuring comprehensive validation across functional, integration, and edge-case scenarios.
- Contribute to task breakdown, estimation, and sprint commitments
- Proactively raise risks, blockers, and testability concerns
- Identify, log, prioritize, and track defects through resolution lifecycle
- Perform root cause analysis and collaborate with development teams for fixes

Manual & Functional Testing

- Design, document, and execute detailed test cases and test scenarios
- Perform functional, exploratory, and regression testing across features
- Validate end-to-end workflows and business scenarios
- Identify edge cases and usability issues through exploratory testing
- Ensure test coverage for areas not suitable for automation

Quality, Standards & Engineering Practices

- Write clean, testable, and maintainable automation code
- Participate in code reviews and continuous improvement of automation frameworks
- Ensure adherence to Definition of Ready (DoR) and Definition of Done (DoD)
- Take ownership of end-to-end quality outcomes across assigned areas
- Follow established DevOps, security, and quality engineering practices

CI/CD & DevOps Integration

- Integrate automation into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred)
- Enable continuous testing and shift-left quality practices
- Monitor and improve pipeline stability, execution time, and reliability
- Validate and troubleshoot system integrations, data flows, and error handling based on defined architectural designs and interfaces

Non-Functional Testing

- Contribute to performance, reliability, and resilience testing
- Validate system behavior under load, stress, and failure scenarios

Observability & Debuggability

- Leverage logs, metrics, and traces to improve test reliability
- Support root cause analysis of failures and improve system observability

Test Data & Environment Management

- Design and manage test data strategies and datasets
- Ensure availability of stable, production-like test environments

Incident & Operational Support

- Assist in troubleshooting defects across environments
- Support maintenance and continuous improvement of automation suites
- Analyze and reduce flaky tests and unstable scenarios

Collaboration & Growth

- Collaborate with developers, QA, Product Owners, and Tech Leads
- Actively learn and adopt new tools, frameworks, and best practices
- Contribute to team knowledge sharing and a strong quality culture

Qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree in computer science, IT, or related field
- 5+ years of experience in software testing with strong automation focus
- Experience in designing and implementing test automation frameworks
- Strong understanding of testing principles, SDLC, STLC, and Agile practices

Technical Skills

- Programming experience in one or more: C#, Java, Python, JavaScript, Swift
- Experience with automation tools such as Selenium, Katalon, Playwright, Cypress
- Experience with:
- API testing (REST, Postman, etc.)
- Version control (Git)
- CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps)
- Familiarity with:
- Test data management
- Test reporting and logging tools
- Debugging and root cause analysis
- Release Management

Assets

- Experience with:
- Performance testing tools (JMeter, k6)
- Security testing (SAST, DAST, SCA)
- Exposure to:
- Cloud platforms (Azure preferred)
- DevSecOps practices
- Experience using AI-assisted tools responsibly (e.g., GitHub Copilot)

Key Expectations

- Drive an automation-first approach (target 60–80% regression automation), while ensuring critical flows and edge cases are validated through manual testing where automation is not feasible or cost-effective.
- Own and evolve automation frameworks and quality engineering practices
- Ensure high reliability, scalability, and stability of automation pipelines
- Take accountability for quality outcomes, not just test execution
- Ensure alignment with organizational quality, security, and compliance standards

Why Husky?

- Regulated Working Hours: Enjoy a structured work schedule that promotes a healthy work-life balance, allowing you to excel professionally while maintaining personal well-being.
- Visible Impact: Experience the satisfaction of seeing the direct outcomes of your work, as you contribute to projects that visibly enhance our company's technological capabilities and efficiency.
- Strategic Influence: Participate in architectural and technical reviews, contributing to the strategic direction of our cloud initiatives and making a tangible impact on our company's technological landscape.
- Empowered Involvement: Take an active role in decision-making processes and architectural reviews, where your expertise helps shape the future of our cloud solutions and overall business strategy.
- Valued Contributions: Be more than just a number in a large organization; at our company, every individual's input is valued and can lead to significant, tangible improvements in our operations and services.
- Impactful Role: Play a crucial part in both developing new applications and maintaining existing systems, ensuring their optimal performance and reliability.

title: Quality Assurance Automation Engineer
description:
About SleekSky

SleekSky builds and runs software for clients who want to scale their technology without heavy overhead - dedicated teams, a startup-inspired culture, and a bias for agility, ownership, and continuous improvement. We combine professional depth with real room to learn, decide, and build things that last.

The role

AI has changed how fast software gets built. Our engineers ship every day with AI assistants writing beside them, and testing has to move at the same speed without becoming the step everything waits for. We're hiring two QA Automation Engineers to make that happen, on a live US healthcare platform with real patients on the other end of it.

Today most testing is still done by hand, one story at a time. An automated suite exists and a release gate is part-built, but neither yet runs reliably enough for anybody to lean on, the regression pass before each release takes about three days, and when something fails it usually lands on a developer first.

You'll write and run the automation, own the environments, configuration and test data you test against, and take every failure first: find out whether it's the code, the configuration, the data or the environment, fix it yourself when it's yours to fix, and hand a developer a reproduction and a failing test when it isn't. Nobody will hand you a test plan or a column of tickets to move.

What you'll own

- Automation that runs without you. A Playwright suite against our web applications and our API, run every night and before every release. When it goes red, you know why the same morning — and a test that can't fail gets fixed or deleted.
- The first look at every failure. An overnight run that went red, a release check that found something, a test environment that stopped working, a defect a support call turned up: it comes to you before it goes to a developer. A missing text message can turn out to be a test number on an opt-out list. You find out which.
- Environments, configuration and test data. Two pre-production environments, stand-in services for the text, email, laboratory and shipping providers, test accounts and seeded data. Real patient data never enters the test estate.
- What never reaches a screen. An API response, the row a scheduled job should have written, a reminder that must go out only once, a file delivered to a partner — checked directly, with API calls, SQL and logs.
- New work, tested as it lands. Against its acceptance criteria and around its edges, with an automated check left behind for anything worth keeping fixed.
- The release regression. From about three days of checking by hand to a suite that runs on its own.

What you'll bring

- 2+ years in software testing, most of it writing automation that ran in a pipeline or on a schedule, with other people relying on the result.
- The habit of chasing a failure to its cause — logs, the database, the configuration, the commit that changed it — and a bug report a developer can act on without a single follow-up question.
- Test code engineers would accept in review. JavaScript/TypeScript and Playwright are our stack; Selenium, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Python or Java are fine if you're willing to move.
- API testing and SQL you can actually use.
- Comfort inside the pipeline and the environment: config files, environment variables, secrets, CI workflows, containers.
- Daily fluency with AI coding tools — Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor or similar — and the discipline to check that every generated test can fail.

A plus, not a requirement: testing text messages, email or automated calls; mock servers; white-labelled or multi-tenant software; healthcare or another regulated field. No certification needed and no healthcare background: the domain takes weeks to learn. What we can't teach quickly is the instinct to go and find out.

Who this isn't for: anyone who wants a test plan handed to them, who would rather report a problem than find its cause, who sees automation as somebody else's job, who needs a finished, stable environment before they can start, or who avoids AI tools — or trusts them without checking.

title: Senior SDET (Python, Playwright, pytest)
description:
Senior SDET (Python, Playwright, pytest)

THE ROLE
Own test automation and quality for Securly Flex, a market-leading EdTech product. Securly Flex is the #1 flexible scheduling software for K-12 schools. It builds time into the school day for intervention and enrichment, and serves as the scheduling engine behind schools' MTSS and RTI programs. Its Autoassign feature uses thousands of data points each night to build the next day's flex period rosters, so students are assigned where they're needed most based on teacher priorities and student needs.
This is a senior engineering role, not a QA role. You will own and scale our Python-based test platform (pytest and Playwright for Python), write the framework code yourself, and define what "ready to release" means for Flex. You'll use AI coding tools such as Cursor, Claude Code and Copilot as an everyday part of how you build and scale coverage.

Location: Pune, India (Hybrid – 2–3 days onsite)
Experience: 6–12 years
Reports to: Director of Quality Engineering

WHAT YOU'LL DO
- Own and evolve the framework. Extend and improve the Flex automation framework in Python (pytest and Playwright): fixtures, reusable libraries, test data utilities, parallel execution (pytest-xdist), and reporting that the whole team builds on.
- Test complex scheduling logic. Automate placement logic, capacity limits, sign-up cutoffs, permissions, and concurrent registrations, at both the API and UI layers.
- Gate every release. Set the CI/CD quality bar and enforce it in the pipeline, so regressions don't reach production.
- Lead with AI-assisted engineering. Use Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot and Playwright MCP to generate scenarios, build faster, and triage failures, and help the team adopt them well.
- Set performance baselines. Measure peak-load moments, such as thousands of students signing up in the same minute, and define what counts as a performance regression.
- Cover web, mobile, and integrations. Own end-to-end coverage across student, teacher, and admin workflows, the mobile app, SIS roster imports and attendance exports, single sign-on, and notifications.
- Shape architecture and mentor. Partner with a Distinguished Engineer on testability decisions, and mentor engineers on test design.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS
Must-Have
- Python and Playwright — strong, production experience writing automation in Python with pytest and Playwright. You understand fixtures and their scopes, test isolation, and modern Playwright practices (role-based locators, auto-waiting assertions, tracing). Strong TypeScript or Java Playwright engineers who are ready to work in Python will also be considered.
- Test framework architecture — you've designed automation frameworks that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts.
- API and business-rule automation — REST and contract testing, plus testing business rules (placement, capacity, eligibility, state transitions), not just UI flows.
- CI/CD quality gates — you've defined what blocks a release, not just written the tests that check it.
- Strong programming — clean, production-quality Python written from scratch, including data structures and logic. You catch edge cases and API contract details, and your test code is held to the same standard as product code.
- Education and experience — Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 6–12 years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience.
Strongly Preferred
- AI coding tools — hands-on use of Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, or Playwright MCP to build tests, generate scenarios, or triage failures.
- Performance and concurrency testing — k6, JMeter, Gatling, or Locust, including burst traffic and race conditions.
- Security and access-control testing — role-based permissions and multi-tenant data isolation.
Nice to Have
- Mobile automation — Appium, Maestro, or Detox for iOS and Android.
- Integration testing — SIS imports and exports, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notifications.
- K-12 EdTech domain — familiarity with school schedules and how districts manage student data.

WHO YOU ARE
- You test the edge cases, not just the happy path.
- You've built and scaled automation frameworks, ideally in Python with pytest, and other engineers have built on what you designed.
- You use AI coding tools as a real part of how you work, and you hold their output to a high bar.
- You're hands-on at a senior level. You still write the framework code and raise the bar for everyone after you.
- You own your area end to end and resolve ambiguity instead of waiting for a perfect spec.

ABOUT SECURLY
Tech Giant Scale. EdTech Innovation. Unmatched Student Impact.
Securly processes over 1.1 billion requests per day and 54 TB of data daily, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools globally. Since pioneering the first cloud-based web filter for K–12 in 2013, Securly has built one of the most trusted, high-scale platforms for student safety, wellness, and engagement.
We are proud to be consistently recognized as a Top Place to Work, named a Top 40 Most Used EdTech platform, and included on the GSV 150 list as one of the most transformational growth companies in digital learning and workforce skills.

SKILLS & REQUIREMENTS
Must-Have
- Python and Playwright — strong, production experience writing automation in Python with pytest and Playwright. You understand fixtures and their scopes, test isolation, and modern Playwright practices (role-based locators, auto-waiting assertions, tracing). Strong TypeScript or Java Playwright engineers who are ready to work in Python will also be considered.
- Test framework architecture — you've designed automation frameworks that other engineers extend. You build the platform, not just the scripts.
- API and business-rule automation — REST and contract testing, plus testing business rules (placement, capacity, eligibility, state transitions), not just UI flows.
- CI/CD quality gates — you've defined what blocks a release, not just written the tests that check it.
- Strong programming — clean, production-quality Python written from scratch, including data structures and logic. You catch edge cases and API contract details, and your test code is held to the same standard as product code.
- Education and experience — Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field, with 6–12 years of hands-on SDET / test automation experience.

Nice to Have

- Integration testing — SIS imports and exports, rostering sync, single sign-on, and notifications.
- K-12 EdTech domain — familiarity with school schedules and how districts manage student data.

WHO YOU ARE
- You test the edge cases, not just the happy path.
- You've built and scaled automation frameworks, ideally in Python with pytest, and other engineers have built on what you designed.
- You use AI coding tools as a real part of how you work, and you hold their output to a high bar.

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.

 Role:

Payments is one of the highest stakes domains at StarRez. When a student pays their housing fees, or an institution reconciles a semester of revenue, the transaction must be correct, traceable, and secure, every time. There is no acceptable margin for a payment that is taken twice, refunded to the wrong account, or lost between our platform and a payment provider. As a Senior Quality Engineer on the Payments team, you will own quality for the systems that process card and bank payments, integrate with payment gateways and providers, and handle authorisation, capture, settlement, refunds, and chargebacks. You will be the person on the team with the deepest understanding of how money moves through our platform, the happy paths, the failure modes, and the states in between. This is a hands-on individual contributor role based in Hyderabad, working within a globally distributed engineering organisation spanning India, Australia, the UK and the United States.

You will not manage people. You will set the quality bar for your team, do the work to hold it, and coach the engineers, product managers and designers around you to share ownership of it. You will report to the Director of Quality and work day-to-day with your team's Engineering Manager, Product Manager and engineers, alongside Support and Implementation Services when payment issues reach customers.

What You Will Own:

- Own the end-to-end test strategy within your team's area, deciding how things get tested based on the risk each change carries. 
- Design validation for payment flows including authorisation, capture, settlement, partial and full refunds, failed and retried transactions, chargebacks, idempotency, and reconciliation between our records and the provider's. 
- Coach and support your team to make of quality everyone's responsibility, and provide hands on support via executing testing activities when required 
- Validate integrations with third party payment gateways and providers. 
- Engage from discovery and refinement onward: challenge assumptions, surface missing scenarios, and make sure acceptance criteria are specific and testable before a story is picked up. 
- Assess your team's current quality maturity honestly, build a plan to lift it over the next two to three quarters, and share what you learn with Senior QAs on other teams facing the same gaps. 
- Coach engineers on testing principles, test design, and shared ownership of automated tests, the goal is a team that builds quality in, not a QA who inspects for it. 
- Mentor mid-level QA engineers on risk assessment, automation, observability and shift left practice. 
- Contribute to CI/CD pipeline health and deployment quality gates: test suite selection, environment readiness, pre and post deploy checks, and safe release strategies including feature flags and staged rollout. 
- Own production defect triage for Payments: assess customer and financial impact, distinguish severity from priority, drive fixes at the right urgency, follow through to root cause & prevention, and provide regular updates on defect remediation. 
- Represent Payments quality in incident reviews and, where needed, in conversations with Support and customer facing teams. 

Required Qualifications:

- 5+ years in quality engineering or software engineering with a deep focus on quality, in complex distributed system environments. 
- Hands on experience testing web-based SaaS products across various levels; front-end, backend, and end to end functional flows. 
- Experience with transactional or financially sensitive systems, payments, billing, banking, e-commerce checkout, ledger or reconciliation systems, or similar. You understand why correctness, idempotency and auditability matter more here than elsewhere. 
- Experience contributing to test automation frameworks and using and have a solid understanding of the testing pyramid. 
- Practical experience working with CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Build-kite, or similar platforms. 
- Experience contributing to deployment and release quality gates, including test suite selection and environment readiness checks. 
- Ability to translate customer needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria, and risk-based test scenarios in collaboration with cross functional teams. 
- Strong root cause analysis and problem-solving skills across complex, multi system failures. 
- Excellent technical communication, you influence engineers, product managers and business stakeholders through evidence and expertise rather than authority. 
- Practical experience using AI in modern software development, with sound judgement about where it helps and where it does not. 
- Genuine curiosity about product architecture, customer workflows, and the business impact of engineering decisions. 

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience testing payment gateway or provider integrations (e.g. Stripe, or similar). 
- Familiarity with payment rail nuances, ACH, SEPA, BACS, or card networks, and how timing and compliance rules affect testing. 
- Exposure to feature flag based or staged rollout strategies for releasing payment features safely. 
- Experience validating reconciliation between internal records and a provider's settlement data. 

Reasons to join our team:

- Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years
- Full benefits including health care, paid time off, and others
- A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities
- Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions.
- Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Even if you don't have all of the Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: ServiceNow QA Automation Engineer
description:
Job Description

BETSOLs team designs and runs software license tracking on ServiceNow SAM Professional. For each software publisher brought into scope, the team analyses contracts, models entitlements and consumption, and delivers a custom publisher view and dashboard that shows licenses owned, licenses consumed and the resulting compliance position. The publishers we work with span SaaS and enterprise software, each with its own license metrics, SKUs and data sources.

We are looking for a QA engineer who can test ServiceNow SAM implementation end to end and keep growing the test automation. You will validate the calculations behind every license number, to prove that dashboards match the underlying report data, and turn repeatable checks into automated scripts so that releases move from development to UAT to production quickly. You will work closely with ServiceNow developers, business analysts and project managers, and with business stakeholders during UAT.

Key responsibilities

Testing SAM publisher implementations

* Review publisher analysis and stories, then write test scenarios and test cases that trace back to the agreed requirements and expected dashboard output.
* Validate entitlement and consumption logic: rights owned, rights consumed, rights available and rights needed, license metrics (for example User Subscription versus Resource Consumption) and custom SKUs created for usage that standard SKUs do not cover.
* Verify calculation rules such as contract term calculation with date tolerance, unit price by billing frequency, weighted average price across entitlements and ratchet behaviour where increases are applied and decreases are not.
* Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts.
* Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line).
* Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances.

Building and running test automation

* Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines.
* Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight.
* Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks.
* Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers.

Quality process and reporting

* Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current.
* Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT.
* Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment.
* Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early. Qualifications

  + Test server-side components on the custom SAM report table, including business rules, script includes, scheduled jobs that run by product group, and audit and data-fix scripts.
  + Reconcile dashboard values against report and source records for each product group, and validate data built from vendor exports and admin API extracts (deduplication, scoping by site and contract line).
  + Run functional, regression and UAT support cycles across the development, test and production instances.

  Building and running test automation

  + Extend the existing SAM automation framework and test scripts, and deliver items on the SAM test automation roadmap against agreed timelines.
  + Automate regression suites for recurring publisher patterns so developers can run them when QA capacity is tight.
  + Use the ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) and server-side scripts to automate data and calculation checks.
  + Keep scripts maintainable, documented and reusable across publishers.

  Quality process and reporting

  + Log, track and retest defects; record evidence and keep test case documents current.
  + Produce a QA sign-off document for each release with test case counts, pass results, defects raised and fixes verified, before promotion to UAT.
  + Support stakeholder reviews of dashboards before production, and fold their feedback into validation before deployment.
  + Take part in sprint ceremonies, estimate QA effort and raise risks to delivery early.

  Qualifications

  Required qualifications

  + Minimum 2 years of hands-on QA experience on the ServiceNow platform, within at least 3 years of overall software testing experience.
  + Working knowledge of ServiceNow SAM Professional or Software Asset Management concepts: entitlements, license metrics, software models, reconciliation and compliance.
  + Practical test automation experience, ideally with ServiceNow ATF, and enough JavaScript to read and write server-side scripts and GlideRecord queries.
  + Strong data validation skills: comfortable reconciling numbers across tables, reports and spreadsheets, and explaining where a figure comes from.
  + Experience writing structured test cases and sign-off reports, and using Jira and a test management tool such as Zephyr.
  + Clear written and spoken English, with the confidence to walk stakeholders through test results and to discuss your own past work in depth.

  Preferred qualifications

  + ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA); a Certified Implementation Specialist in Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM) is a strong plus.
  + Exposure to software licensing models for SaaS and enterprise publishers (named user, subscription, resource or consumption based).
  + Experience testing REST API integrations and vendor usage exports.
  + Familiarity with Agile delivery and ALM tools such as Jira.

title: Automation Tester
description:
**Role & res**

**Role purpose**

Create and maintain dependable automated checks that protect X3 customer behavior and give X3 squads fast feedback on every change, release and migration asset.

**X3 context**

Sage X3 is the SaaS-readiness programme for X3: a progressive transformation from tightly coupled legacy runtime patterns towards portable, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities. The programme protects customer behaviour, partner IP and rollback while it modernises journeys, APIs, components, data paths, business logic, delivery automation and migration economics.

The role contributes to outcome-owned squads. India is a scalable engineering and product delivery centre, connected to Europe and North America through deliberate overlap, shared standards, recorded decisions and continuous support of production outcomes.

**Core accountabilities and decision ownership**

* Develop automated UI, API, GraphQL, integration and regression tests from clear risks and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain test data, environments, diagnostics and documentation so failures can be reproduced and fixed efficiently.
* Contribute tests to CI/CD quality gates and help identify flaky, missing or redundant coverage.
* Learn X3 processes, metadata and customisation patterns so automation reflects real customer outcomes.
* Participate in defect analysis, release verification, upgrade checks and rollback rehearsals.

**Decision ownership:**

Test implementation for assigned stories, defect evidence, coverage recommendations and escalation of quality or environment risks.

**Common capability baseline**

All X3 roles are expected to build capability in the following areas. Depth and decision scope increase with level:

* Understand X3 customer workflows, metadata, customisation and architecture well enough to protect supported behaviour, partner investment and SaaS readiness in the decisions owned by the role.
* Treat the internal platform as a product: use developer and operator research, feedback and adoption evidence to reduce cognitive load; provide self-service APIs and golden paths where they solve a demonstrated need.
* Use cloud-native service boundaries, versioned API contracts and event integration where appropriate, preserving compatibility and clear ownership across X3 capabilities.
* Apply CI/CD and secure software-supply-chain controls, with identity, secrets and policy enforcement built into relevant delivery and runtime paths.
* Make services diagnosable with OpenTelemetry-compatible logs, metrics and traces; define role-appropriate SLOs, reliability and resilience evidence.
* Manage performance and cost deliberately, and engineer lifecycle, upgrade, deprecation and rollback paths as part of supported capability ownership.
* Use migration, reconciliation and compatibility evidence to preserve customer data and behaviour while moving towards portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable capabilities.
* Use AI-assisted engineering securely, with human review, privacy and IP protection, regression evidence and a recovery path; use deterministic methods when they are more appropriate.
* Depth follows role scope: engineers demonstrate hands-on lifecycle capability in their discipline; managers, product and programme leaders, and architects need decision-relevant fluency, not universal coding or every tool. Containerisation and Kubernetes are required for all engineering roles. Infrastructure as code, GitOps and a custom internal developer platform apply where the role owns those paths.

**Required technical and domain skills**

* Professional experience in software testing or automation and a willingness to write production-quality code.
* Working knowledge of one automation language and tools for API, UI or service testing.
* Foundational understanding of enterprise business workflows (ERP or similar), Agile delivery, CI/CD and source control.
* Basic SQL/data validation and REST/SOAP integration testing, with interest in batch and migration workflows.
* Interest in GraphQL, PostgreSQL/data paths, Web/Syracuse, observability and cloud operations.
* Hands-on experience with containerisation and Kubernetes.
* Good English communication, attention to detail and a habit of recording evidence.

**Modern platform skills for this role**

* Build automated API, event, integration and regression checks into CI/CD; validate compatibility and migration reconciliation, keep failures diagnosable, and learn the teams secure artifact, telemetry and rollback practices.

**Preferred skills**

* TypeScript/JavaScript, Playwright/Cypress, API contract testing or SQL Server/Oracle.
* Sage X3, ERP, manufacturing, distribution or finance testing experience, including L4G/4GL or Crystal Reports.
* Performance, accessibility, security or migration testing exposure.

**Experience and qualifications**

Typically 2+ years in software testing, quality engineering or development, with practical automation experience. Degree, diploma or equivalent experience in computing or engineering is desirable.

Professional English is required for global collaboration. Equivalent practical experience is valued alongside formal qualifications.

**Expected outcomes / success measures**

* Stories have relevant automated checks and clear, reproducible evidence.
* Regression suites remain reliable and useful as components, APIs and customisations change.
* Defects are found earlier, described precisely and linked to customer impact.
* The engineer steadily expands domain knowledge and contributes to safer release and migration practice.

*Measures should be agreed with the squad and reviewed through the X3 monthly scorecard and quarterly evidence gates. For this role's owned scope, show how customer behaviour and partner investment are preserved, capabilities become portable, secure, cloud-operable and upgradeable, and quality, reliability, supportability and rollback are proven. Include safe migration and improved cost or delivery economics where relevant.*

**Key stakeholders and collaboration model**

Works with Software Engineers, Senior Automation Engineers, Product, Cloud Support/L3, Security and Customer Services in a distributed squad, with India-based execution connected to Europe/North America overlap.

**Sage behaviours / leadership expectations**

Customer Focus, Action Orientation, Trust, Innovation and Collaboration. Is curious, precise, open to feedback and willing to learn the domain behind the test.

*Every colleague is expected to protect customer continuity, partner investment, security and the integrity of evidence. Leaders additionally create clarity, develop talent and make accountable decisions visible.* **ponsibilities**

title: QA Automation Engineer
description:
**Experience:** 4+ years (3+ years with an advanced degree)

**Only candidates from Tier 1 institutes are eligible to apply.**

**Mandatory Skills**: Python / TypeScript / Java, Playwright / Cypress / Selenium, API testing (RestAssured / Postman / Newman), CI/CD test gating, automation framework design

**Role Summary**

Build and own the automation framework and regression suite that decides whether a release reaches production, with real authority to stop a deployment. This is an engineering role, not manual testing with some Selenium attached: you join the design conversation and test for logical failures, not just visual ones.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Framework: API and UI automation built as a codebase with the same standards as the product.

* Regression suite: Fast enough that people run it and trustworthy enough that a red build means something.

* Release gating: Define and enforce pre-production validation and criteria for going to production.

* Contract and integration tests: Across services and across the boundary with connected organisations.

* Quality signal: Defect triage, coverage and escape metrics that leadership can act on.

* Testing blind: Design test data, fixtures and failure diagnosis that work without reading personal data payloads.

* Proving a negative: Test that an append-only, tamper-evident consent ledger cannot be quietly subverted.

* Withdrawal propagation: Verify across a distributed system, including failure paths, that a withdrawal reaches every connected organisation.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* 4 years building test automation as software, or 3 years with an advanced degree, or equivalent practical experience.

* Has designed an automation framework from scratch, not only written tests inside someone else’s.

* Strong programming in Python, TypeScript or Java.

* Playwright, Cypress or Selenium at depth, and API testing with RestAssured, Postman/Newman or equivalent.

* Tests wired into CI as a gate that can genuinely block a release.

* Test design as a discipline: risk-based coverage, boundary and negative cases, and judgement on what not to automate.

* Hands-on use of AI-assisted testing tools for authoring, maintenance or coverage analysis.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Contract testing between services (Pact or equivalent).

* Performance and load testing with JMeter, k6 or Locust.

* Security testing fundamentals: OWASP Top 10, authentication and authorisation edge cases, injection paths.

* Mobile test automation, ideally Flutter.

title: Senior Quality Assurance Analyst
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

Kyndryl is on the lookout for a Quality Assurance Software Engineer who is passionate about delivering top-notch cloud-based managed services to our clients. As a QA Software Engineer at Kyndryl, you will be at the forefront of ensuring that our software products meet the highest standards of quality, reliability, and performance.

**Your Role**  
Your role will involve using your expertise to define test strategies, test specifications, test cases, and test plans based on design documentation, functional specifications, and high-level design documents. You will work closely with other engineering squads/tribes to develop new features and products, and ensure that the implemented components are feature, integration, and system tested before being released to our customers.
  
  
You will also be responsible for automating test cases to build test suits for regression, scalability, and performance testing. You will analyze, track, and verify defects during the software development lifecycle, and contribute to designing, developing, implementing, executing, and troubleshooting automated test tools, test frameworks, and test scripts for application and API testing.

**What You Will Do**  
As a QA Software Engineer at Kyndryl, you will be the go-to person for developing, executing, and maintaining automation tests for acceptance, functional, and regression test cases for the identified areas/modules/technology. You will also be responsible for accurately documenting and communicating issues to developers to facilitate elimination of problems and to create efficient fixes.
  
  
At Kyndryl, we believe in promoting testing best practices and principles across the organization, and as a QA Software Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in determining these practices and principles. You will also be responsible for leading quality engineering discussions and mentoring other QA Engineers in debugging, planning, and domain expertise.
  
  
If you are a fast learner who thrives on challenges, likes to learn new solutions, and can step into the shoes of the end user to see the product from a consumer’s point of view – then we want you on our team. Apply today and become part of a dynamic and independent squad of Engineers who are dedicated to delivering quality cloud-based managed services to our clients.
  
  
**Your Future at Kyndryl**  
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**  
  

* 6 years of experience testing complex software products for large enterprise customers in a fast-paced agile environment
* Deep understanding of the QA processes, standards, tools and technologies
* Experience with testing and successfully delivering complex features/products for web-based enterprise applications and automating UI, CLI, and API testing
* Practical knowledge in at least one or two open-source automation tools and frameworks
* Good understanding of the entire software development life cycle
* Proficient analytical and problem-solving skills . Collaborative communication and team working skills

  
**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**  
  

* Familiarity with test frameworks like Selenium, Protractor etc.
* Use of scripting languages like Python, Perl, PowerShell, and Java script to create scripts rapidly that can integrate into the testing stage within a pipeline
* Use of Test-Driven Development (TDD), SDLC, and Agile software development practices

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

**Get Referred!**

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

This job focuses on the creation and maintenance of automated test scripts, ensuring alignment with software engineering standards. The role requires executing tests, analyzing results, and reporting defects to enhance product quality. Key responsibilities include collaborating with developers to integrate testing strategies, crafting detailed documentation, and contributing to code reviews. The position requires staying current with test automation advancements and repairing scripts of intermediate complexity with some guidance.

**Job Description**

As an SDET 2, you will be responsible for ensuring the quality and reliability of web and mobile applications through effective manual and automated testing. You will design and execute test strategies, develop and maintain automation, identify and communicate quality risks, and collaborate with developers, product managers, and cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.

Technical Skills Must Have

* Strong experience in Manual Testing for Web and mobile applications
* Solid understanding of test design, execution, and defect management

* Exposure to Agile/Scrum methodologies

* Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and integration of test suites
* Exposure to Git skills to maintain high-quality automation code

Key Responsibilities

* Perform end-to-end manual testing for iOS applications and web applications ensuring high-quality deliverables
* Design, develop, and maintain automated test scripts using WebdriverIO
* Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and cross-functional teams to understand requirements and define test strategies
* Identify, log, and track defects through resolution with clear documentation
* Participate in test planning, test case design, and execution activities
* Ensure test coverage across functional, regression, and integration testing
* Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, and frameworks
* Support automation integration into CI/CD pipelines for faster releases

title: Senior SDET Analyst
description:
**Summary of This Role**
------------------------

Performs and participates in application development and testing to apply continuous quality and testability of code throughout the software development lifecycle. Builds quality within the software development process with automated testing suites providing a comprehensive view from code quality to functionality. Uses quality paradigms to provide real time quality with use of automation and frequent regression testing. Designs / develops and maintains automation frameworks and automation test suites and scripts with continuous integration, testing, deployment and delivery. Conducts performance, load, security and service virtualization testing.

**What Part Will You Play?**
----------------------------

* Participates in all steps of the software development life cycle and is accountable for producing quality code. Collaborates with peers to identify and recommend practices for quality assurance at the source using automation. Conducts impact analysis, evaluates and identifies affects to regression test suites, testability of code, and application performance to reduce negative influences on continuous testing. Performs quality checks along with updating of automation scripts. Identifies and designs testing suites for test driven development (TDD) and behavior driven development (BDD) to allow early and frequent testing as the software is developed. Identifies process improvement and continuous quality measures across the development lifecycle.
* Writes and executes application tests at the source code level to prevent hidden errors (i.e., white box testing) within unit and component testing. Identifies and suggests improvements for code quality to improve deficiencies from functionality through structure of code for performance and maintainability. Builds, maintains and reviews mid-level unit and component test suites and conducts automated white box tests. Identifies improper coding and code quality issues. Integrates white box test suites with continuous integration (CI) tools. Programs and creates mid-level test cases using unit and component testing tools for code level testing.
* Develops moderately complex software tools, frameworks and utilities for validation / verification activities and end-to-end functional testing of software. Identifies and recommends tools and frameworks for testing and creates automated tools for generic use and maintainability. Writes moderately complex code that uses / exercises non-user interface (UI) components like application program interface's (API's), representational state transfer API (RESTful API), and web services similar to the end user to develop frameworks for testing. Integrates automated suites with continuous integration (CI) tools for frequent execution.
* Installs and uses moderately complex CI frameworks in continuous testing and continuous deployment / delivery. Builds, customizes, and deploys moderately complex test environments and test automation frameworks. Performs moderately complex scripting, data generation, and other methods to maintain automation infrastructure throughout the development. Integrates CI tools with other testing infrastructure and develops moderately complex reporting / metrics on CI.
* Develops test scripts, test data, and analyzes / interprets performance, load and security testing. Conducts testing, analysis and interprets results using service virtualization testing tools that emulates the behavior of necessary dependent system components that are unavailable or difficult-to-access. Identifies virtualization testing opportunities with approaches and designs to testing virtualized environments. Identifies performance testing opportunities with approaches and designs to test for application performance, load, security and service virtualization. Analyzes systems and database performance and responses during loads. Directs tests to avoid common application performance bottlenecks. Maintains and administers procedures, methodologies and/or application standards to include payment card industry and security related testing compliance using automation and built-in security tests during development. Applies virtualization concepts to identify tests and application scenarios impacted by virtualization. Incorporates performance, load and security testing into CI environments.
* Works with stakeholders, business, developers and test analysts to develop more intricate test plans, conditions and cases (set of inputs, execution preconditions, and expected outcomes developed for a particular objective, such as to exercise a particular program path or to verify compliance with a specific requirement) to be used in testing. Develops and administers best practices to perform test data conditioning and execution of test sets. Works with programming to create certain account conditions and execute special testing requirements for test validation. Demonstrates a broad knowledge of the multiple environments by evaluating, interpreting and communicating an understanding of the various components of systems and applications to leadership.
* Acts as a single point of contact for assigned moderately complex client projects with regard to test engineering activities. Coordinates the test activities assigned to the test team to include, reviewing of client test plans cases and scripts, prioritizing test execution when necessary and providing feedback to internal and external clients.

**What Are We Looking For in This Role?**
-----------------------------------------

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree; additional experience in lieu of degree will be considered.
* Typically Minimum 4 Years Relevant Exp - Professional experience with Software testing, coding, designing, and developing.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's Degree - Software Engineering, Information Systems or other Technical degree
* Typically Minimum 6 Years Relevant Exp - Experience developing automated testing strategies in a variety of environments and frameworks

**What Are Our Desired Skills and Capabilities?**
-------------------------------------------------

* Skills / Knowledge - A seasoned, experienced professional with a full understanding of area of specialization; resolves a wide range of issues in creative ways. This job is the fully qualified, career-oriented, journey-level position.
* Job Complexity - Works on problems of diverse scope where analysis of data requires evaluation of identifiable factors. Demonstrates good judgment in selecting methods and techniques for obtaining solutions. Networks with senior internal and external personnel in own area of expertise.
* Supervision - Normally receives little instruction on day-to-day work, general instructions on new assignments.
* Software Development Life Cycle / Testing Methodologies - Agile - Scrum, Kanban, Test Driven Development, Behavior Driven Development, etc.
* Programming Languages - Java, C#, Perl, Python, Groovy, Oracle, SQL, etc.
* Testing tools - Application Lifecycle Management, Unit Testing, Security, Application Programming Interface, Mobile, Continuous Integration, Service Virtualization, etc.

title: Software Test Engineer
description:
**About Voxtron**

Voxtron Solutions LLP is a technology solutions company focused on delivering enterprise software solutions, digital transformation services and business applications. We develop and implement software solutions that help organisations streamline business operations, improve productivity and enhance operational efficiency.

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive **Software Test Engineer** to join our team at Infopark, Kochi. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability and performance of our software solutions, particularly in the areas of Human Resource Management Systems (HRMS) and Asset Management.

Candidates with hands-on experience testing HRMS and Asset Management applications are required. Experience in testing enterprise products and participating in product development and release cycles will be an added advantage.

**Role Overview**

The Software Test Engineer will be responsible for understanding business requirements, preparing test scenarios, executing functional and regression testing, identifying defects and working closely with development and product teams to ensure the delivery of high-quality software.

The role requires a good understanding of business workflows, the ability to identify functional gaps and edge cases, and a systematic approach to software quality assurance.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Requirement Analysis and Test Planning**

* Understand business requirements, functional specifications and user stories.
* Analyse requirements and identify test scenarios, business rules, dependencies and potential gaps.
* Prepare test plans, test scenarios, test cases and test data.
* Identify positive, negative, boundary and exception scenarios.
* Participate in requirement clarification and design discussions with business analysts, developers and product teams.
* Ensure adequate test coverage for functional requirements.

**2. Functional Testing – HRMS**

* Perform functional testing of HRMS modules and business workflows.
* Validate employee lifecycle processes, including employee onboarding, employee records, transfers, promotions and separation.
* Test leave management, attendance, shift management, overtime and employee self-service functionalities.
* Validate payroll-related workflows, salary structures, allowances, deductions and payroll calculations, where applicable.
* Test approval workflows, employee requests, notifications and role-based access.
* Validate HR reports, dashboards and data exports.
* Verify integrations with biometric attendance devices, payroll systems and other external applications, where applicable.

**3. Functional Testing – Asset Management**

* Test end-to-end asset lifecycle management processes.
* Validate asset creation, categorisation, allocation, assignment and return workflows.
* Test asset transfers, maintenance, repair, depreciation and disposal processes, where applicable.
* Verify asset tracking, ownership, employee-to-asset mapping and location-based tracking.
* Validate asset approval workflows, alerts, notifications and audit trails.
* Test asset reports, dashboards and reconciliation-related functionalities.
* Ensure accuracy and consistency of asset information across relevant modules.

**4. Functional and Regression Testing**

* Execute functional, integration, system and regression testing.
* Validate end-to-end business scenarios across different modules.
* Perform retesting of resolved defects and ensure that fixes do not impact existing functionalities.
* Test application behaviour across supported browsers, devices and screen resolutions.
* Identify inconsistencies in business logic, calculations, workflows, validations and user interfaces.
* Verify data integrity and consistency across interconnected modules.

**5. Defect Management and Coordination**

* Identify, document and report software defects with clear reproduction steps.
* Classify defects based on severity and business impact.
* Maintain defect logs and track issues through resolution.
* Work closely with developers to reproduce, analyse and validate reported defects.
* Perform retesting and regression testing after defect fixes.
* Communicate testing progress, blockers and quality risks to the project or product team.

**6. Product Development Testing**

* Participate in testing new product features and enhancements.
* Validate new functionalities against approved requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Test product releases, patches and upgrades.
* Identify usability issues, functional gaps and potential improvements.
* Support release validation and production-readiness assessments.
* Maintain reusable test scenarios and regression test suites.

**7. Documentation and Reporting**

* Maintain test plans, test cases, test execution reports and defect reports.
* Prepare test completion and quality status reports.
* Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases and defects.
* Document test evidence and maintain appropriate testing records.
* Contribute to improving QA processes, standards and testing practices.

**Mandatory Skills and Experience**

* Previous hands-on experience as a Software Tester, QA Engineer or Software Test Engineer.
* Practical experience in testing **HRMS solutions**.
* Practical experience in testing **Asset Management solutions**.
* Good understanding of enterprise application workflows and business processes.
* Strong knowledge of functional testing, regression testing, integration testing and system testing.
* Ability to analyse requirements and independently prepare detailed test scenarios and test cases.
* Experience in defect identification, documentation, tracking and retesting.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
* Strong attention to detail and ability to work systematically.
* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work effectively with developers, business analysts and product teams.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

The following skills and experience will be considered an advantage:

* Experience in testing enterprise software products or SaaS applications.
* Experience working in a product development environment.
* Exposure to test automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright or Cypress.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman.
* Basic SQL knowledge for database validation and backend data verification.
* Understanding of web technologies, browser behaviour and client-server architecture.
* Experience with test management and defect tracking tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps or similar.
* Experience in testing mobile applications.
* Exposure to Agile / Scrum development methodologies.
* Knowledge of payroll, attendance, employee self-service and asset lifecycle management processes.

**Educational Qualification**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics or a related discipline.
* Relevant software testing certifications will be an added advantage.

**Key Competencies**

* Strong analytical and logical thinking.
* Good understanding of business processes and application workflows.
* Ability to identify edge cases and potential functional issues.
* Ownership and accountability for testing deliverables.
* Effective collaboration and communication.
* Ability to manage multiple testing activities and meet release timelines.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, products and business domains.
